page.layout: One page of text, one column; running head at top with page number at top left; dateline and a bare numeral below the text.

main_text.p: Solum ut ingenue fatear te agnosco, Illustrissime Princeps, quem secundum Deum imprimis oportet Legationem istam ad exitum perducere. Quapropter Celsitudinem Vestram rogo, ut quemadmodum hactenus affecta fuit erga hoc negotium, sic deinceps quoque laudem tam sancto opere dignam, suo ductu authoritate, prudentia & consiliis acquirat. Ego interim Deum Opt. Max. oro, ut Celsitudinem Vestram cum Celsitudinis Vestrae Illustrissima Familia quam diutissime sospitem conservet.

page.notes: Several words are damaged by ink spots, notably "sospitem" (the word is partly obscured by a blot, reading uncertain) and "agnosco" and "Celsitudinem". The dateline is in italic with mixed type; "Birme" and "Iunii" are read as printed. The "LXVIII" at lower right is a bare numeral, copied as printed. Scattered specks across the lower page are not printed text.
